lines.greeting: Sorry Pip, I’m snowed under with work… Could you dust my walls for me? I’ve got a video call in 30 seconds! I’ll give you 100 coins.
lines.hurry: Quick, my call’s about to start!
lines.rewarded: Spotless! You saved my life. Here are your 100 coins.
lines.failed: Oh no, the call’s started… Shall we try again?
lines.alreadyDone: You already saved me today. Come back tomorrow, there’ll be plenty more dust!
lines.unavailable: Ouch, my computer crashed… Try again in a moment.

lines.greeting: Heh heh, fancy a game of memory, youngster? Find the 8 pairs in 20 moves at most… and I’ll give you 150 coins. But I warn you, I never lose!
lines.rewarded: Well I never, you beat me! What a memory. Here are your 150 coins, well earned.
lines.failed: Ha ha! Out of moves! Don’t worry, I’ve had a hundred years to practise. Another round?
lines.alreadyDone: One defeat a day is quite enough for my pride! Come back tomorrow.
lines.unavailable: Hmm, I’ve mislaid my cards… Try again in a moment.

1.text: Patience is a tree with bitter roots, but very sweet fruit.

2.text: Fall seven times, stand up eight.

3.text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

4.text: The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now.

6.text: Dripping water hollows out the stone.

7.text: Ask, and you look a fool for five minutes. Don’t, and you stay one forever.

8.text: When you drink water, remember the spring.

9.text: The bamboo that bends is stronger than the oak that resists.

10.text: The frog at the bottom of the well knows nothing of the ocean.

11.text: One day with a good teacher is worth a thousand days of study.

13.text: If you are in a hurry, take the long way round.

14.text: You can’t see the forest with your nose against a tree.

15.text: The slow tortoise goes further than the sleeping hare.

16.text: A smile costs less than electricity, but gives as much light.

17.text: Even a long journey is made one cup of tea at a time.

18.text: The nail that sticks out gets hammered down.

19.text: Learning is like rowing upstream: stop, and you drift back.

20.text: Kind words cost nothing and are worth a lot.

21.text: A house without books is like a body without a soul.

23.text: A friend knows the song of your heart.

24.text: Be not afraid of going slowly, only of standing still.

25.text: Even the tallest tower starts from the ground.

26.text: The wind doesn’t always blow the way the boat wants.

27.text: When the wise man points at the moon, the fool looks at the finger.

28.text: Better to light a candle than to curse the darkness.

29.text: Memory is a garden: it needs watering every day.

30.text: Flipped cards never lie, but they love to hide.

boy.name: Lucas

lines.greeting: Oh no! I dropped my things in the lake again… Can you help me fish them out? I’ll give you 50 coins! And if you find my treasure box, the booster inside is yours!
lines.rewarded: Thank you! I knew it was down there. Here are your 50 coins!
lines.rewardedShiny: MY TREASURE BOX!!! I’ve been looking for it for days!!! Here, the booster that was inside is yours!!!
lines.failed: Oh, stopping already? There’s loads more stuff at the bottom, you know!
lines.alreadyDone: You already helped me today! Come back tomorrow, I’m sure to drop something else…
lines.unavailable: Oh, my line’s all tangled. Try again!
